claim_boundary: This proves the ROM-derived S-SMP producer of the second $BBAA after the real S-CPU command $18 for every retained timer phase and all conservatively retained DSP phases. It does not use the hybrid endpoint as authority, select a physical oscillator phase/rate, or yet prove the complete parallel route beyond the S-CPU wait-loop release.

join.meaning: The S-CPU command $18 is already stable, every retained S-SMP timer profile is at the proved $087E service-loop join, and no S-SMP port-1 read occurs between the S-CPU write and this join.
